We need general cookie hardening category - we have only recommendation for session tokens, but we need general ones.

comments.body: Do we need to worry about protecting non-session cookies? Do we have a valid use-case for really sensitive data being stored in a cookie aside from session tokens?

> Do we have a valid use-case for really sensitive data being stored in 
a cookie aside from session tokens?

Absolutely not, this is not a good idea, ever. There are no good ways to 
store sensitive data in a browser based app - unless you start looking 
at browser based crypto which is primitive still
valid comments. solution - do not use cookies for sensitive data (covered 8.2.2).

title: move 3.4 cookie-based requirement as general (not only session management specific)
